title: JASON ROSS B2B TRIVECTA LIVE @ LOST IN DREAMS 2025 (FULL SET) 4K
description:
Went b2b with Trivecta at Lost In Dreams and it was unreal. One of the most fun sets I’ve ever played - hope you enjoy the ride :)
